question: What attainment follows from meditating on the deity in this prescribed form?
premises: The practitioner meditates in the manner described.
The meditation is addressed to Maheśānī.
The result is becoming a holder of all knowledge.
inference: Meditating thus on the goddess leads the practitioner to become a holder of all knowledge.
plain_english: O Maheśānī, by meditating thus one becomes a possessor of all knowledge.
